lines.text: The LORD tells Joshua to choose twelve men, one from each tribe, to take twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan.
The stones will be a memorial for the children, and the Israelites carry twelve stones to the camp.
The priests with the ark leave the river first, and then about 40,000 armed troops cross into the plains of Jericho.

wrong_details.wrong: The priests with the ark leave the river first
wrong_details.true: The priests stood in the middle of the Jordan until the people finished crossing, then crossed last

lines.text: When the priests come up onto dry land, the waters return, and the people camp at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.
Joshua sets up the stones at Gilgal, saying the LORD dried up the Jordan as He did the Sea of Galilee, and the kings rejoice.

wrong_details.wrong: as He did the Sea of Galilee
wrong_details.true: just as He did to the Red Sea
their hearts melted and their spirits failed for fear
